heading: Wave 16: Large cross-cutting migrations (last)

briefs.focus: drizzle-orm 0.45.2 as installed (read node_modules/drizzle-orm sql/sql.d.ts, pg-core/columns/*.d.ts, pg-core/dialect.*, utils.d.ts): sql template, sql.identifier, sql.param(value, encoder) and how PgDialect.sqlToQuery applies a column's mapToDriverValue (PgJsonb JSON.stringify, null), getTableColumns(table), PgColumn.getSQLType() output for integer, double precision, jsonb, text, boolean and pgEnum, and Table['$inferInsert']. Confirm that Postgres types untyped INSERT ... SELECT params as text, so each needs an explicit ::type cast, and that a null param cast to ::jsonb gives SQL NULL. Confirm how both drivers run one serializable statement: @neondatabase/serverless 1.x transaction([...], { isolationLevel: 'Serializable' }) and postgres 3.4 begin('isolation level serializable') with unsafe(text, params). Read these first: src/db/index.ts (runSerializable, :111), src/db/serialization-retry.ts, src/db/pg-errors.ts, src/features/industry-planner/profiles/queries.ts (createIndustryProfile), src/features/custom-structures/schema.ts, src/features/industry-planner/schema.ts and src/db/__tests__/support/db-test-harness.ts.

zod 4.5.4 as installed (read node_modules/zod v4 type definitions, not memory). Cover z.input, z.output and z.infer; z.strictObject versus z.object; whether .extend throws on an object that carries .superRefine in 4.5.4, and when to use .safeExtend instead; whether a .superRefine'd strictObject still works as a z.discriminatedUnion option; z.ZodType generic parameters for a ConvexDoor<P, Req, Res> interface with a const path generic; and `satisfies` checks of a schema against a domain type (EliminationDeduction, JumpMatchOutcome). Also cover TypeScript distributive conditional types with `infer C extends string` for P138's ProblemCodeOf over a union of failed outcomes, and why keyof over a union of response maps keeps only the shared statuses. Read these first: src/lib/convex-http-door.ts, src/transport/endpoint.ts (OutcomeOf, ProblemCodec, ProblemBodyFor), src/transport/decode.ts, src/lib/problem.ts (retryAfterSeconds), src/lib/id-schemas.ts, convex/httpJump.ts and src/composition/jump-resolver/convex-door.ts.

convex 1.45.0 and convex-test 0.0.56 as installed. Cover httpRouter().route({ path, method, handler }) and whether a const door.path typed as `/${string}` is accepted; httpAction and PublicHttpAction; and what the default (non-Node) runtime can bundle when convex/ imports src modules through the @/ alias in convex/tsconfig.json. Door modules must pull in no node: imports and no fetch-client or env code transitively. Also cover convex-test's t.fetch for HTTP routes. Confirm that convex/_generated changes only when Convex function modules or exports change, and that `pnpm exec convex codegen --typecheck disable` regenerates it. Read these first: convex/http.ts, convex/lib/httpAuth.ts (authorizedJsonAction), convex/__tests__/http.setup.ts, convex/__tests__/modules.setup.ts, convex/__tests__/export-coverage.test.ts, convex/httpAccountMerge.ts, convex/httpMapAccess.ts, convex/httpLocation.ts and convex/httpEngine.ts.

tailwindcss 4.3.3, class-variance-authority 0.7.1 and tailwind-merge 3.6.0 as installed. Cover the @theme tracking and font tokens (--tracking-optical, copy, label, wide, eyebrow; --font-ui, data, display) and the utilities they generate. For cva, cover variants whose value is '', defaultVariants, boolean variants (wrap: { true, false }) and VariantProps, and confirm that cva concatenates class and className without merging. For tailwind-merge, cover extendTailwindMerge theme and classGroups, so that cn(eyebrow(), 'tracking-label') and font overrides resolve correctly. Read these first: src/app/globals.css (tracking tokens at about :342-346, the html/body font-ui rule at about :449-457), src/components/ui/cn.ts, src/components/ui/type-roles.ts (eyebrow, displayTitle), src/components/ui/page-head.tsx, src/components/ui/section-head.tsx and src/components/ui/dialog.tsx.

vitest 4.1.11 as installed. Cover vi.hoisted plus vi.mock with a top-level await import, as create-profile.test.ts does, and whether vi.mock('@/db') also intercepts a relative ./index import from a new src/db/capped-insert.ts. Cover mockResolvedValueOnce chains, and type-level assertions (expectTypeOf, or @ts-expect-error in test files). vitest typecheck mode is not configured; `pnpm check` runs tsc --noEmit, so confirm that tsc covers test files. Cover running *.db.test.ts suites against local Postgres; they skip when it is down, and a skip is not a pass. Read these first: vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json, src/features/industry-planner/profiles/create-profile.test.ts, src/db/serialization-retry.test.ts, src/db/__tests__/support/db-test-harness.ts, src/esi-datasets/ui-adoption.test.ts with src/lib/__tests__/source-scan.ts, and src/lib/convex-http-door.test.ts.

waveCautions: P219: runSerializable already retries serialization failures (src/db/serialization-retry.ts, 10 attempts). insertWithinCap therefore adds no retry, and no retry tests need to move. Rename profile-writes.ts insertWithinCap, or fold it into createIndustryProfile, so two modules do not export the same name. DB tests must actually run on local Postgres; a skip is not green. P138 needs P063, P054 and P146 landed first. Its copy changes (feedback detail dropped, 429 copy from retryAfterSeconds, cross_origin fallback) need red-to-green tests and PR-body notes. AccountDangerZone now toasts inline after gate.run (P056), and it is a hotspot: one PR touching it at a time. P046: panel titles are already done through displayTitle. Phase 2 must produce identical classes (eyebrow defaults to font-medium). Phase 3 changes visuals and needs user review on /preview/primitives. The census regex also matches Footer tracking-[0.03em] and HeroBanner tracking-[0.28em], works per file, and skips every ui directory. P246 needs P208: wrap its merge-contract, leave-contract and MAP_CLAIM_REVOKE_BATCH rather than redeclaring them, and move its Convex-only userPurgeBodySchema into lib. Check whether zod .extend throws on refined objects. Switch postConvexHttpDoor and all 9 callers in one commit. Convex must never import convex-http-door.ts or transport. The strict snapshot parser must match Convex's real response. Notes left by earlier waves: P306 sees AccountDangerZone importing HelpPopover from ui/help-popover (P007), not Popover. Serialization-failure retries live in runSerializable (wave 5).
